citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, architecture
citations.excerpt: Kolibri is an English-German Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with 78B total parameters, 3B active.

citations.label: tej.as, independent Kolibri tokenizer measurement on legal German
citations.excerpt: On legal German, Kolibri needed 15% fewer tokens than GPT-5’s tokenizer, even more than Aleph Alpha’s own 11.2%. In English it tied with it.

citations.label: tej.as, Kolibri training data provenance (restating the vendor model card)
citations.excerpt: Sovereign doesn’t mean that nothing from outside Europe went in. The model card says so itself: English web text was rephrased with Google’s Gemma 4 , German with Mistral-NeMo . Qwen3-32B labeled data for the quality filters.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, sovereign positioning
citations.excerpt: Kolibri is a specialized language model built for sovereign mission-critical work in regulated areas including public administration, industrials and aerospace.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, German compression claim
citations.excerpt: Because of the 21% German share in our data, it compresses German language better than other SOTA models.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, sovereignty definition
citations.excerpt: Sovereignty, for us, combines two dimensions: how we built the model, and how it transfers to our customers.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, supply-chain integrity claim
citations.excerpt: We offer full supply-chain integrity and account for every decision, from data ingestion, through pre- and post-training, to the final evaluations.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, deployment freedom claim
citations.excerpt: Customers have full freedom of deployment and intellectual-property safety, so compliance comes as an inherited property of the model.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha blog, Kolibri release, German rephrasing method
citations.excerpt: The second was to rephrase German documents we already had. An LLM rewrites an organic German document in the style of an encyclopedia entry, a Q&A dialogue or a text passage, preserving its content.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha Kolibri-1 model card, synthetic data policy
citations.excerpt: We generated synthetic data using permissively-licensed LLMs.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha Kolibri-1 model card, German rephrasing model
citations.excerpt: German synthetic rephrasings of web data were produced with Mistral-NeMo-12B.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha Kolibri-1 model card, English rephrasing model
citations.excerpt: Deduplicated English Common Crawl was rephrased with Gemma-4-26B-A4B following a Nemotron-CC-style recipe, using five prompt templates applied to each seed document: diverse QA pairs, distillation, knowledge list, knowledge extraction, and encyclopedia-style rewriting.

citations.label: Aleph Alpha Kolibri-1 model card, quality-classifier annotations
citations.excerpt: LLM-as-a-judge annotations using Qwen3-32B over randomly sampled English Common Crawl were generated as training data for our text-quality classifiers
